diagrams.title: **The section on one page
diagrams.caption: **The section on one page.** Three homes for the agent, plus two services you can add to any of them.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 470" aria-label="A decision map. Question 1: is each request short, independent and triggered by an event? Yes: AWS Lambda. Question 2: is it always running, with no user sessions, or does it need custom networking, GPUs or a whole agent team in one container? Yes: Amazon ECS on Fargate. Question 3: is it a multi-turn conversation for many users who must be isolated, with auth and observability you'd rather not build? Yes: AgentCore Runtime. Alongside any of them: many existing APIs to expose as tools, use AgentCore Gateway; users and external credentials to manage, use AgentCore Identity." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
